{"subject": "Reviewing cash in the Sato Household account", "body": "Hi Sato Household,

I am writing as your adviser to suggest a review of the cash held in your account. As of our last meeting on Jul 30, 2026, your cash position was USD 117,295, or 9.3% of AUM. With USD 54,295 identified as excess cash, it may be worth discussing how that balance fits your plan.

Your household has been a client since 2019, and your largest holding is the Total market ETF (VTI) at 47.7% of AUM. I would like to talk through your cash needs and any upcoming plans before we consider next steps.

Your next review is due Jul 30, 2027. Please let me know a convenient time for a conversation.
